recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to HumanName part extensions or the assembly-order value set should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack or THO, not by reintroducing duplicated core definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-12351 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 MnM change request to rework HumanName for nl/de/es naming needs: make HumanName.family 0..1, retain the family string as the correct display value while decomposing parts by extension, add flat family-name-part extensions, add a HumanName assembly-order extension with v2/Dutch codes, and clarify family-name search expectations.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 10241. Git commit 25c2c4b3101b908faefd466feecfb8b299ac68b6 maps to that revision and applied '#12351 - family name changes' by updating source/datatypes/humanname.xml, adding source/datatypes/humanname-extensions.xml, and registering the HumanName extension spreadsheet in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-12310 was retracted in favor of the DevDays 2016 flat-extension solution that became FHIR-12351. Current source/fhir.ini keeps HumanName as an active datatype and the HumanName extension profile entry, but the concrete HumanName extension definitions have moved to the FHIR Extension Pack. The Extension Pack defines the six requested family-part extensions and the assembly-order extension/value set; THO supplies NL1-NL4 name-assembly-order codes and the ValueSet represents unknown with v3 NullFlavor UNK. Current string-search rules and family SearchParameters cover portion/contains matching for family names.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current FHIR core source change is needed. The core datatype preserves the 0..1 family cardinality and decomposition model, search semantics cover the family-name search concern, and the requested extension artifacts are maintained outside the core checkout.

related_jiras.note: The earlier iso21090 voorvoegsel request was retracted in favor of the flat HumanName.family extension approach implemented by FHIR-12351.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive MnM issue requiring HumanName.family to become 0..1, flat family-part extensions, a name assembly-order extension, and family-name search guidance.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final WG decision and defines the reconciliation target for the current HumanName source check.

evidence_items.summary: Git-svn commit '#12351 - family name changes' maps Jira's svn revision 10241 to source/datatypes/humanname.xml, source/datatypes/humanname-extensions.xml, and source/fhir.ini changes.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied historically in the authoritative datatype and extension-spreadsheet sources.

evidence_items.summary: Current core lists HumanName as an active datatype, keeps HumanName.family at 0..1, and says family names may be decomposed into parts using extensions.
evidence_items.learned: The core datatype still conveys the main FHIR-12351 cardinality and decomposition model.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack defines humanname-own-name, own-prefix, partner-name, partner-prefix, mothers-family, fathers-family, and assembly-order with HumanName/HumanName.family contexts and the assembly-order ValueSet binding.
evidence_items.learned: The requested extension artifacts have not been lost; they are now maintained outside the core checkout.

evidence_items.summary: THO name-assembly-order is active and contains NL1 Own Name, NL2 Partner Name, NL3 Partner Name followed by Maiden Name, and NL4 Own Name followed by Partner Name.
evidence_items.learned: The Dutch assembly-order codes requested by FHIR-12351 remain available via the terminology binding; unknown is represented in the ValueSet by v3 NullFlavor UNK.

evidence_items.summary: Current search rules define normalized string search, :contains string matching, and Patient?family as a portion of the family name.
evidence_items.learned: The current search specification covers the relevant portion/separator behavior without a new HumanName-local note.
